格兰古瓦在市场巷道逃跑迷路。: Pierre Gringoire runs away and gets lost in the market alleys.
格兰古瓦误入奇迹宫，被判处吊死；艾丝美拉达答应与他结婚相救。: Pierre Gringoire mistakenly enters the Court of Miracles and is sentenced to be hanged; Esmeralda saves him by agreeing to marry him.
两人进入房间，谈论婚姻；佳丽在场。: The two enter a room and discuss marriage; Djali is present.
幼年卡西莫多被放置于圣母院弃婴床。: The infant Quasimodo was placed on the foundling bed at Notre-Dame.
克洛德把幼弟让送到磨坊乳母处。: Claude sends his younger brother Jehan to the wet nurse at the mill.
弗罗洛多次到公墓关注弗拉梅尔墓上的图案。: Frollo goes to the cemetery multiple times to study the patterns on Nicolas Flamel's tomb.
原文说弗罗洛曾悄悄进入旧弗拉梅尔房屋。: The text states that Frollo once secretly entered the old house of Nicolas Flamel.
弗罗洛沿伦巴第街前往该房屋。: Frollo heads to that house via Rue des Lombards.
弗罗洛在塔楼设置隐秘研究小室。: Frollo sets up a secret study in the tower.
夸克蒂埃带化名来客拜访弗罗洛；该来客为路易十一。: Jacques Coictier brings a visitor under an alias to visit Frollo; this visitor is Louis XI.
化名 Tourangeau 的身份由本章末尾明确，未凭外观推断。: The identity of the alias Tourangeau is made clear at the end of this chapter, not inferred from appearance.
卡西莫多受审；聋法官弗洛里安主持，后有罗贝尔到场。: Quasimodo is put on trial; presided over by the deaf judge Florian, with Robert arriving later.
法官弗洛里安、罗贝尔以及旁听者让均在本章有明确到场记述。: Judge Florian, Robert, and the spectator Jehan are all explicitly recorded as present in this chapter.
三位妇人和孩子到隐修室窗前交谈。: Three women and a child come to the recluse's window to converse.
卡西莫多在示众台受鞭刑；让在群众中嘲笑，随后艾丝美拉达给水。: Quasimodo is flogged at the pillory; Jehan mocks him in the crowd, and then Esmeralda gives him water.
P60–65 为登示众台与递水的具体段落。: Pages 60–65 are the specific paragraphs for the pillory scene and giving water.
弗比斯在未婚妻家，艾丝美拉达受邀进入后离开。: Phoebus is at his fiancée's home; Esmeralda is invited in and then leaves.
格兰古瓦表演杂技，艾丝美拉达在前广场跳舞。: Pierre Gringoire performs acrobatics while Esmeralda dances in the parvis.
弗罗洛从塔楼观察前广场；下楼时看见卡西莫多也在注视。: Frollo observes the parvis from the tower; descending, he sees Quasimodo watching as well.
格兰古瓦跟弗罗洛进教堂，在柱边谈话。: Pierre Gringoire follows Frollo into the church and talks by a pillar.
让沿竖琴街往西岱岛方向走。: Jehan walks along Rue de la Harpe toward the Île de la Cité.
让路过于谢特街街口闻到烤肉味。: Passing the intersection of Rue de la Huchette, Jehan smells roasting meat.
让从小夏特莱门洞穿过。: Jehan passes through the gateway of the Petit-Châtelet.
让上塔楼找兄长并躲藏偷听。: Jehan goes up the tower to find his elder brother and hides to eavesdrop.
沙尔莫吕拜访弗罗洛，让藏在室内。: Jacques Charmolue visits Frollo, with Jehan hiding in the room.
让与弗比斯饮酒后出来，弗罗洛在外监视。: Jehan comes out after drinking with Phoebus, and Frollo watches from outside.
弗比斯带披斗篷的弗罗洛走上桥。: Phoebus takes the cloaked Frollo onto the bridge.
法卢德尔引两人上楼，弗罗洛进入藏身空间。: Falourdel guides the two upstairs, and Frollo enters a hiding space.
艾丝美拉达与弗比斯会面；弗罗洛藏在隔壁后行刺，守夜人抵达。: Esmeralda meets with Phoebus; Frollo hides in the next room and then strikes him, and the watchman arrives.
格兰古瓦入内旁听，认出受审的艾丝美拉达；法卢德尔作证。: Pierre Gringoire enters to listen and recognizes Esmeralda on trial; Falourdel testifies.
艾丝美拉达遭刑讯，沙尔莫吕与刑吏在场。: Esmeralda is tortured, with Jacques Charmolue and the torturer present.
刑讯后回审判室宣判，格兰古瓦仍在旁听。: After torture, she is brought back to the courtroom for sentencing, with Pierre Gringoire still attending as a spectator.
艾丝美拉达囚于司法宫地下，弗罗洛前来。: Esmeralda is imprisoned in the dungeons of the Palais de Justice, and Frollo arrives.
来客身份由本章对话与自述确立。: The visitor's identity is established by the dialogue and self-revelation in this chapter.
弗比斯伤后前往连队驻地。: Phoebus goes to the company barracks after his injury.
弗比斯回到未婚妻家。: Phoebus returns to his fiancée's home.
艾丝美拉达被带到教堂前，卡西莫多救入圣所；弗罗洛在仪式现场。: Esmeralda is brought in front of the church, and Quasimodo rescues her into the sanctuary; Frollo is at the ceremony site.
卡西莫多将艾丝美拉达安顿在教堂高处庇护小室。: Quasimodo settles Esmeralda in the high sanctuary cell of the cathedral.
弗罗洛夜间闯入庇护处，卡西莫多干预。: Frollo breaks into the sanctuary at night, and Quasimodo intervenes.
P18、24–27 明确冲突及人物身份。: P18, 24–27 clarify the conflict and character identities.
格兰古瓦在外看雕刻，弗罗洛找到他。: Pierre Gringoire is outside looking at sculptures when Frollo finds him.
两人走到伯纳丁街停下谈话。: The two walk to Rue des Bernardins and stop to talk.
弗罗洛回教士区，在房门口遇到等候的让。: Frollo returns to the cloister and encounters Jehan waiting at his door.
奇迹宫酒馆集结；格兰古瓦、克洛潘、让及马蒂亚斯在场。: Gathering at the Cour des Miracles tavern; Pierre Gringoire, Clopin, Jehan, and Mathias are present.
克洛潘等围攻圣母院，在贡德洛里埃宅邸门廊下商议。: Clopin and others besiege Notre-Dame, conferring under the porch of the Maison Gondelaurier.
卡西莫多主要位于塔楼高处，分开记录。: Quasimodo is primarily located high in the towers, recorded separately.
卡西莫多在高处观察并利用材料防御。: Quasimodo observes from high above and uses materials for defense.
国王在巴士底狱处理动乱消息；格兰古瓦被带到面前。: The King handles news of the riots at the Bastille; Pierre Gringoire is brought before him.
分别据正文对话及身份指认记录，不把谈论过的人物自动算到场。: Recorded separately based on text dialogue and identity confirmation, without automatically assuming discussed characters were present.
格兰古瓦离开巴士底狱后沿圣安托万街奔走。: After leaving the Bastille, Pierre Gringoire runs along Rue Saint-Antoine.
格兰古瓦在博杜瓦石十字架旁与弗罗洛碰头。: Pierre Gringoire meets Frollo by the Baudoyer stone cross.
弗比斯率王军来援，克洛潘一方被击溃。: Phoebus leads royal troops to the rescue, and Clopin's faction is routed.
P3、6–7 明确弗比斯率军与克洛潘参战；不据此认定格兰古瓦也参战。: P3, 6–7 specify that Phoebus leads troops and Clopin participates; this does not establish that Pierre Gringoire also participated.
格兰古瓦与披黑衣的弗罗洛进入小室，带艾丝美拉达和佳丽离开。: Pierre Gringoire and Frollo, dressed in black, enter the cell and take Esmeralda and the goat away.
一行人下楼穿过教堂。: The group goes downstairs and through the cathedral.
从红门进入教士区庭院。: Enter the cloister courtyard from the Red Door.
穿过庭院向 Terrain 河岸门走。: Walk across the courtyard toward the Terrain riverbank gate.
抵达 Terrain 尖端，登上预先停靠的小船。: Reach the tip of Le Terrain and board the pre-positioned boat.
一行人乘船离开西岱岛，经岛端向干草港去。: The group leaves the Île de la Cité by boat, passing the end of the island toward Port-au-Foin.
船靠港，格兰古瓦带佳丽离开，弗罗洛带艾丝美拉达走。: The boat docks, Pierre Gringoire leaves with the goat, and Frollo leaves with Esmeralda.
弗罗洛沿河把艾丝美拉达带到格雷沃广场。: Frollo takes Esmeralda along the river to the Place de Grève.
艾丝美拉达与隐修女相认，追捕者到窗前。: Esmeralda recognizes the Recluse, and the pursuers arrive at the window.
卡西莫多搜寻失踪的艾丝美拉达，随后在塔上看到处刑并面对弗罗洛。: Quasimodo searches for the missing Esmeralda, then watches the execution from the tower and confronts Frollo.
P6–10 确立塔楼到场关系，P33–34 为结局。: P6–10 establish tower presence relations, and P33–34 are the ending.
艾丝美拉达死后遗体被运往藏尸窖。: After Esmeralda's death, her body is transported to the charnel house.
后日发现相拥遗骨，文本以形体与衣物暗示人物身份。: Embraced skeletons are discovered later, with the text implying identities through physical form and clothing.
不能把遗骨发现时刻记成两人同时活着到访。: The moment of discovering the skeletons cannot be recorded as a visit where both were alive at the same time.
艾丝美拉达被带到绞刑架；母亲追随阻止，库赞执行处刑。: Esmeralda is brought to the gallows; her mother follows to stop the execution, which Henriet Cousin carries out.
不要将两位在圣母院塔上远观的人物标作此地到场。: Do not label the two characters observing from afar on the Notre-Dame tower as present at this location.
叙述者提及后日寻找奥利维耶遗体时发现相拥遗骨。: The narrator mentions discovering the embraced skeletons later while searching for Olivier's body.
